verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes official managed remote MCP servers. These include the recommended Code Mode server at mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp, which covers the entire Cloudflare API including Workers, plus Workers-specific servers for Bindings, Builds and Observability. Auth is OAuth or a bearer API token, and an agent-setup hub plus a Skills plugin walk through connecting Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting agents through these servers works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: allowing you to connect to Cloudflare's service from an MCP client (e.g. Cursor, Claude) and use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account
provides access to the entire Cloudflare API — over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust, and every other product — through just two tools: search() and execute()
Just connect to the MCP server URL - you'll be redirected to Cloudflare to authorize and select permissions.
Cloudflare provides Skills and MCP servers so your agent can seamlessly build on the Cloudflare platform.
